notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
Crystalline Crawler does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare Crystalline Crawler and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Byrke's second ability triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Crystalline Crawler has at least six +1/+1 counters on it, this combo nets infinite +1/+1 counter doubling.
You may also attack with one or more Warriors each combat phase to gain 1/1 Warrior creature tokens from Najeela.

uses.name: Byrke, Long Ear of the Law
